screens.name: today
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-fidelity Japanese desktop web-app UI mockup, flat front-on screenshot, landscape 1536x1024. This is screen 01 of a coherent 12-screen redesign of Tree Kids School's staff newsletter tool, named 「ツリー通信v2」, embedded inside a reservation portal.
Input image 1 is the OFFICIAL LOGO, a supporting insert, NOT a style to redraw. Place the supplied entire logo PNG intact in a modest white area in the upper left sidebar, preserve aspect ratio, all Japanese and English lettering, tree and red apple. Never create an alternative tree icon as a logo.
Visual direction: refined, calm, humane Japanese education-service workspace. Warm ivory #F7F7F1 workspace, pure white working surfaces, forest green #225B45 primary actions and sidebar selection, muted sage dividers, tiny ochre status accents. Dark green-gray highly readable Japanese typography, restrained 6–8px corners, generous 24px gutters, thin dividers, subtle shadows. Elegant editorial hierarchy, efficient data table, NO glossy gradients, no glass, no oversized decorative widgets, no fictional character mascot. Desktop only, full interface with no laptop frame.
Top thin pale strip EXACT: 「01 / 12　今日の通信」 left, 「UI/UXモックアップ・表示内容は作例」 right.
Portal topbar 「Tree Kids School 予約」, tabs 「予約」「ツリー通信v2」「スタッフ」.
Left sidebar about 180px: full official logo, product title 「ツリー通信v2」, navigation 「今日の通信」 selected, 「出欠と送迎」「通信を書く」「コピーと送信確認」「支援記録と書類」「施設日報と勤務」「通信の履歴」 then below divider 「データ管理」「設定・使い方」.
Main context row: 「事業所A」 select, 「2026年10月6日（火）」 with previous/next arrows, small 「ブラウザー内仮保存」.
Main heading 「今日の通信」 with understated subtitle 「小さな気づきを、一人ひとりの言葉に。」, primary button 「通信を書く」 and secondary 「児童を追加」.
Slim progress summary with 4 areas 「利用予定 6名」「作成中 2件」「入力完了 3件」「送信確認済み 1件」 and a small segmented bar. Status totals: 1未着手 +2作成中 +3入力完了=6, 送信確認済み is1 of3 completed, keep distinct not additive.
Work area split 72% table /28% side rail. Table filter pills 「全員 6」「未着手 1」「作成中 2」「入力完了 3」. Table columns 「児童」「担当」「メモ」「通信の入力」「送信確認」「操作」. 6 fictional children labeled 「児童A」「児童B」「児童C」「児童D」「児童E」「児童F」, staff A/B/C. Rows mixed text badges 未着手, 作成中, 入力完了; one separate green 「確認済み」 and five 「未確認」. First row highlighted soft sage with action 「続きを書く →」, completed rows 「確認する →」. No personal photographs.
Right rail title 「今日の活動」 with two items 「14:30 モザイクアート」「15:30 外遊び」 and staff owner, button 「日報をひらく」. Below a quiet note 「あとから読んでも、その日の姿が浮かぶ通信に。」 in Japanese serif. Small utility line at bottom 「欠席 1名　キャンセル待ち 1名」 with expansion affordance.
Bottom design annotation strip 「設計意図：入力の進み具合と送信確認を分け、次の仕事が分かる入口に。」.
Constraints: all depicted data fictional, no real children's names or photo. This is a concept only, do not claim cloud sharing or real LINE auto-send. Keep Japanese exact, readable and consistent. Dense enough to preserve actual functionality, uncluttered enough to work.
